title: chromolaena arnottiana
intro: Chromolaena arnottiana, commonly known as Jacobinia or Jacobina, is a species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. It has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, pain, and inflammation, due to its health benefits, such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Chromolaena arnottiana include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and inhibit the growth of microorganisms, making it a valuable plant in folk medicine. The bioactive constituents of Chromolaena arnottiana include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
